build_modality_specific_encoder: build a ModalitySpecificEncoder with local encoder, context encoder, and ALiBi bias configuration
create_mask_info: create MaskInfo with unmasked features, binary mask, restore indices, and keep indices
compute_random_masking: compute random masking on sequence features using a seed for reproducible token removal
generate_alibi_bias: generate ALiBi positional bias tensor for attention heads with configurable slopes and dimensions
apply_channel_masking: apply channel-wise masking to encoder features using configurable mask probability and length
